The yellow giraffe color should improve by specifying one clearly bright yellow giraffe and not applying yellow to other objects.

The giraffe color clause was present but not emphasized strongly enough as the single giraffe's dominant color.

regression_risks: The seven trumpets could regress in count if the prompt over-focuses on the turtles.
The trumpets-to-left-of-turtles relation could regress if the right-side turtle-and-giraffe arrangement becomes centered too broadly.
